notes: West 6th Street from Plum to Elm is the 120' market space (printed 120'; north face y=1357, south face y=1777) with the Jabez Elliott building in the middle; its centreline is y=1568. East of Elm, 6th is a normal 66' street (north face y=1550), so Elm/West 6th is the middle of the four block corners (y=1616); the 120' centreline is y=1568 and the 66' centreline east of Elm is y=1664. Thorpe Alley and Hatters Alley jog at Plum (west-of-Plum pieces y=2073 and y=2874, east-of-Plum pieces y=2143 and y=2802), recorded as separate Ts. East of Elm the outline of the sheet 31 block shows Thorpe Alley 31 px north (y=2112, recorded as its own T) and Longworth continuing as the 40' Opera Place; sheet 31's own drawing puts the east-of-Elm Thorpe south of the west piece instead, so the east-of-Elm stubs here are schematic. Hatters Alley continues east of Elm within 10 px, recorded as a cross. Two north-south alley lines cross the blocks (all their junctions are recorded as intersections, so the alleys list is empty): x~1627 (unnamed 10' from 6th to Thorpe, printed only 'ALLEY' from Thorpe to Longworth, 'HOLCOMB (HOWARD)' from Longworth to Hatters, unnamed from Hatters to 5th; the 'TIN CL 2nd' box at its 5th Street mouth is a second-storey bridge, so the alley is taken as open to 5th) and x~2320 (unnamed 10' from 6th to Thorpe, 'ALLEY' Thorpe to Longworth, blocked by the Post building, then 'HABIG (COOPER)' 10' from Hatters to 5th). Longworth carries a pasted label 'POST SQUARE (LONGWORTH)' between Holcomb and Elm; recorded as Longworth Street.
